title: Specify the rendering of <details> in more detail.
body:
This makes a number of related changes to specify the rendering of the `
` element: * It specifies the structure of the user agent shadow tree. This appears largely interoperable between implementations with the exception of the style or link element for the default summary styles: Gecko uses a link element as the first child, Chromium uses a style element as the last child, and WebKit does not use a style element (see below). This specifies a style or link as the last child with a note that the order is not observable. * It specifies the existence of the default summary and the presence of UA dependent text inside of it. This is present in all of Chromium, Gecko, and WebKit. * It specifies the styles needed for the default summary. These match Chromium and Gecko. (These are not present in WebKit because WebKit's mechanism for styling the marker does not match the existing spec; see [bug 157323](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=157323).) * It removes the restriction that `
` is a block and cannot be changed. This is prototyped in Chromium and Gecko. This fixes #9830. * It specifies that the summary element is display: block by default. This matches all of Chromium, Gecko, and WebKit. * It specifies which element matches the `::details-content` pseudo-element. This is prototyped in Chromium. * It makes a potentially riskier change by making the `slot` element that matches `::details-content` be `display: block` all the time (rather than only when closed). This is prototyped in Chromium (more recently than the other changes). See https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/9879 and https://github.com/w3c/csswg-drafts/issues/9951 for more background. - [X] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * Chromium *support*, see [issue 40068507](https://issues.chromium.org/issues/40068507) * Gecko *position pending*: shown partial interest based on [bug 1856374](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1856374) but that's only a piece of this; remainder is covered by https://github.com/mozilla/standards-positions/issues/1027 * WebKit *support*: https://github.com/WebKit/standards-positions/issues/351 - [ ] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://wpt.fyi/results/html/rendering/the-details-element/details-display-type-001.tentative.html * https://wpt.fyi/results/html/rendering/the-details-element/details-display-type-002.tentative.html * https://wpt.fyi/results/html/rendering/the-details-element/details-pseudo-elements-001.tentative.html * https://wpt.fyi/results/html/rendering/the-details-element/details-pseudo-elements-002.tentative.html * https://wpt.fyi/results/html/rendering/the-details-element/details-pseudo-elements-003.tentative.html * https://wpt.fyi/results/html/rendering/the-details-element/details-display.tentative.html (just added by https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/46844) * PR to make non-tentative: https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/46847 - [X] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: [issue 40068507](https://issues.chromium.org/issues/40068507) * Gecko: [bug 1901037](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1901037) * WebKit: [bug 275211](https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=275211) - [X] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: https://github.com/mdn/mdn/issues/559 - [X] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
